target_customer: Software teams that want company-specific background coding agents they can self-host
problem: Teams want agents with their own sandboxes, secure access to internal services and event triggers. Proliferate offers an open-source, MIT-licensed, self-hostable platform with multiplayer sessions and live previews.
business_model: Open source core with a hosted cloud tier using usage-based credits (per aggregator snippet)

founders.name: Pablo Hansen
prior_employers: Onyx (YC W24), hire #1 for about a year
education: Master's degree in AI, finished at age 19 per YC page (institution not named)
founders.background_notes: Only founder listed on the YC page.

competitors.name: Cursor background agents
competitors.what: Cloud background coding agents plus a web app to manage them

technical_complexity.rationale: Sandboxed agent runtimes with secure access to internal systems, event triggers and multiplayer sessions are hard for a one-person team.

defensibility.rationale: MIT licensing makes copying trivial and large coding-agent vendors ship similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Cursor and others shipped background agents in 2025; no acquisition of Proliferate found.

market_need_then: Coding agents were spreading in 2025, and teams wanted autonomous background runs; evidence of demand for self-hosted versions is the company's own positioning.

branding.domain_note: Uses proliferate.com; the company was first called Keystone.

identity.voice_and_tone: Tagline: Do your life's work with agents

rebrands.why: Not stated; YC page says fka Keystone

branding.community_and_virality: YC Launch post titled Proliferate, the open source company coding agent; no merch found.

brand_strength.rationale: Early brand with a rename and no independent brand coverage.

outcome_analysis: Proliferate is an active solo-founder open-source company, formerly Keystone, in a crowded coding-agent market where Cursor and others shipped background agents during 2025. No outcome event was found, and funding is unconfirmed, so the trajectory is unclear.
notes: Funding unverified: a search snippet attributes a $5.2M seed (True Ventures, Twenty Two Ventures, Valkyrie Ventures, Pear VC, Ritual Capital) to a YC job listing, but the listing returned 404 when opened; another aggregator says $5M from Pioneer Fund and YC in August 2025. Neither confirmed, so no round recorded. proliferate.com did not resolve from this session (network restriction). Founder education institution not named.
